change_laws: Never weaken a gate to obtain a green result
Prefer existing canonical seams over parallel infrastructure
continuity_law: Nayas do not lose memory. A cold successor must reconstruct relevant identity, authority, state, intelligence, evidence and next action without manual replay.
enforcement_expectation: These laws are acceptance criteria; they should appear in agent instructions, tests, reviews and proof receipts where applicable, not merely in prose.
intelligence_laws: Conversation is source material, not automatically canonical truth
Relationships are auditable semantic assertions, not decorative links
Learning is meaningful only when it can influence later authorized behavior and that influence is independently evidenced
purpose: The non-negotiable laws set of the constitution: truth laws, intelligence laws, change laws, the continuity law, and the enforcement expectation.
title: CONSTITUTION / LAWS
